purpose: Record the P22-12 help command family physical split proof after moving help files into a dedicated subpackage.
policy: The help family is physically split, but command registration, topic routing, stdout/stderr behavior, and docs-check coverage must remain stable through the command package adapter.

dryRunFindings.finding: printHelp now writes through a small commandHelpPrinter adapter, so help extraction does not move global IO helpers.
topLevelHelpAliases, nestedHelpAliases, canonicalHelpTopic, and trimHelpTopicPositionals stay in the help family and are covered by topic boundary tests.
NO_COLOR golden tests pin Usage, Available Commands, Flags, and Examples rendering for representative root, nested, and plugin topics.

physicalSplitAdmission.nextAllowedAction: After P22-13 doctor preflight refresh, proceed to P22-14 by moving only the doctor family in a dedicated commit.
physicalSplitAdmission.rollbackRequirement: Restore all help/*.go files to cmd/gofly/internal/command and remove help_adapter.go in one commit if topic routing, help rendering, docs-check, or CLI surface gates regress.
